:::{#sol-cv-estimate-by-fold}

The folds $\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{k}$ partition $\set{1, \ldots, n}$ (@def-folds),
so summing over the observations of each fold and then over the folds
adds each term of @eq-cv-estimate exactly once.
For $i \in \fold{j}$, @eq-fold-assignment also puts $i$ in $\fold{\foldof{i}}$,
and the folds are disjoint,
so $\foldof{i} = j$.
Then

$$
\ba
\cvest{k}
&= \frac{1}{n} \sumin \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{i}}{x_i} - y_i}
&& \text{(definition)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{n} \sum_{j=1}^k \sum_{i \in \fold{j}} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{i}}{x_i} - y_i}
&& \text{(group by fold)}
\\
&= \frac{1}{n} \sum_{j=1}^k \sum_{i \in \fold{j}} \sqf{\fittedwo{j}{x_i} - y_i}
&& (\foldof{i} = j \text{ for } i \in \fold{j})
\ea
$$

In the last line, the rule $\fittedwo{j}{\cdot}$ depends only on the outer index,
so each inner sum uses a single fitted rule.

:::
